description.value: Sessions Outdoor Sports is a family-owned shop in Osoyoos founded by the McLean family, serving locals and visitors with bike repairs, e-bike and bicycle rentals, ski and snowboard servicing, and outdoor gear across all seasons. Situated in the heart of the South Okanagan cycling corridor, it positions itself as the go-to stop for riders exploring the lake paths, vineyard routes, and mountain bike trails around Osoyoos. A touring cyclist would find mechanical help, rental options, and local route knowledge all under one roof.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and confirms Sessions Outdoor Sports is an active, family-owned bike shop in Osoyoos offering repairs, e-bike and bicycle rentals, and multi-season outdoor gear. The bike repair subpage explicitly states 'the fastest tube and tire changes in Osoyoos' and 'e-bike servicing,' and a customer review confirms a flat was fixed during a walk-in visit. No evidence of a floor pump, washrooms, DIY stand, or device/e-bike charging stations appears anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Sessions Outdoor Sports is an active, full-service bike shop in a prime cycling destination offering repairs, e-bike servicing, and rentals — a clear fit for the WWC directory that would benefit touring cyclists visiting the Osoyoos area.
enrichment_extras.notes: The rental page mentions a delivery option ('Call the shop to learn more about delivery options and have your bikes ready right where you need them') which could be relevant for touring cyclists; not flagged as shuttle/trip support since the context is rental delivery only.

Same-day urgent repairs.detail: 'The fastest tube and tire changes in Osoyoos' on the repair page; customer review confirms a flat was fixed immediately during a walk-in visit

E-bike service.detail: Repair page headline: 'Fast, reliable repairs - from flat tires to full tune-ups and e-bike servicing.'

Bike rentals.detail: Dedicated rental subpage offers e-bikes (Maui Molly with 500W Bafang motor, 48V Samsung battery, up to 100 km range) and standard bicycles, with half-day, 7-hour, and 24-hour+ multi-day options

wow_evidence: family-owned shop in Osoyoos founded by the McLean family
